name: js-url-resolve
instruction: Implement resolveUrl.js (CommonJS): module.exports = resolveUrl. resolveUrl(base, ref) resolves a URI reference against a base URI per RFC3986 section 5.3, INCLUDING the remove_dot_segments algorithm. Do not use the built-in URL class. An empty reference returns the base without its fragment; a reference that is only a query replaces the query and drops the base fragment; a reference that is only a fragment keeps the base query. '..' segments that would escape the root are discarded rather than producing leading '..'.
verifyCmd:
node <<'VERIFYJS'
const r = require('./resolveUrl.js');
const B = 'http://a/b/c/d;p?q';
const cases = [
  ['g', 'http://a/b/c/g'],
  ['./g', 'http://a/b/c/g'],
  ['g/', 'http://a/b/c/g/'],
  ['/g', 'http://a/g'],
  ['//g', 'http://g'],
  ['?y', 'http://a/b/c/d;p?y'],
  ['g?y', 'http://a/b/c/g?y'],
  ['#s', 'http://a/b/c/d;p?q#s'],
  ['g#s', 'http://a/b/c/g#s'],
  ['', 'http://a/b/c/d;p?q'],
  ['.', 'http://a/b/c/'],
  ['..', 'http://a/b/'],
  ['../', 'http://a/b/'],
  ['../g', 'http://a/b/g'],
  ['../..', 'http://a/'],
  ['../../g', 'http://a/g'],
  ['../../../g', 'http://a/g'],
  ['/./g', 'http://a/g'],
  ['/../g', 'http://a/g'],
  ['g.', 'http://a/b/c/g.'],
  ['.g', 'http://a/b/c/.g'],
  ['g..', 'http://a/b/c/g..'],
  ['./../g', 'http://a/b/g'],
  ['./g/.', 'http://a/b/c/g/'],
  ['g/./h', 'http://a/b/c/g/h'],
  ['g/../h', 'http://a/b/c/h'],
  ['http://x/y', 'http://x/y'],
];
for (const [ref, want] of cases) {
  const got = r(B, ref);
  if (got !== want) { console.error('FAIL ref=' + JSON.stringify(ref) + ' got=' + got + ' want=' + want); process.exit(1); }
}
console.log('ok');
VERIFYJS
